summary: Tested new PromptStarterPanel (dynamic personalized+rotating cards) and new onboarding auto-scan on POST /projects/add. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (auth-required, ownership 403 leak-check, 404 unknown project, personalized-first ordering, generic pad, invalid-repo project-add doesn't 5xx and returns promptly). Frontend: all UI acceptance criteria pass — 5 cards render with correct data-testids, security note present, clicking a card prefills composer exactly ('I want a contact form on my website') without auto-sending, used card is replaced in same slot within ~1s (build-something-new -> build-something-new-alt), auto-rotate confirmed after ~20s wait (18s interval), panel remains visible while user types but not sent, composer toolbar/mode selector/send button regression-clean. No console errors during flow.
critical_code_review_comments: PromptStarterPanel `useEffect` fetch swallows the `cancelled` flag correctly BUT the promise's `.then` closure references `cancelled` from the outer scope — fine as-is, no bug, just noting.

routers/findings.py::starter_suggestions — the finding cursor sorts by ('severity', 1) which puts 'critical' BEFORE 'high' only because 'c' < 'h' alphabetically; this works accidentally but is fragile. Consider explicit severity ordering (e.g., map to numeric weight) so a future severity value like 'crisis' or 'catastrophic' doesn't silently break the ordering contract.

services/project_onboarding_scan.py — good defensive `try/except`, no PII leaked in log messages. Consider a debug log for the `not (github_token and github_owner and github_repo)` early-return path so silent no-ops are traceable.

PromptStarterPanel: fallback pool has only 10 items and pool exhaustion path recycles via `FALLBACK_POOL.find(...)` — after repeated clicks with a small backend pool, users may see the same 'alt' slugs cycle predictably. Minor UX polish, not a bug.

cto_projects.py line 1098 imports run_onboarding_scan inside the try block after the auth_method branch — if get_installation_token throws for github_app path, the onboarding scan is skipped (because it's in the same try). This is acceptable (indexing also skipped) but worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PromptStarterPanel + onboarding auto-scan verified end-to-end on preview. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_prompt_starter_onboarding.py exercises: auth-gate, owned project (200), unowned project (403 not_your_project), unknown project (404 project_not_found), personalized-first ordering, generic pad >=5, POST /projects/add still <25s and non-5xx with a bad PAT (proving the new fire-and-forget onboarding scan doesn't block the response). Frontend UI verified via Playwright: cards render, click prefills exact example string, used-card swap happens instantly, auto-rotate triggers within ~20s. Empty-state gate (`messages.length<=1`) confirmed via 'New run' button on dashboard. No frontend console errors observed.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified, no bugs found.
